title: Point-Cloud-Assistant Localized Statistical Channel Prediction by Tangent Gaussian Splatting
abstract: arXiv:2606.18734v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate, site-specific channel information is crucial for optimizing next-generation wireless networks. Among various approaches, localized statistical channel modeling (LSCM), which models the channel multipath angular power spectrum (APS) from the reference signal received power (RSRP) measurement, has emerged as a state-of-the-art method tailored for efficient network optimization. However, despite its effectiveness, LSCM cannot predict APS at the vast majority of locations where no measurements are available, which significantly restricts its applicability in large-scale, real-world scenarios. To address this challenge, we present point-cloud-assisted tangent Gaussian splatting (PC-TGS), the first framework to extrapolate APS to unmeasured outdoor grids by integrating sparse radio measurements with dense LiDAR-based geometry. translated_title: 点云辅助的切向高斯溅射局部统计信道预测
translated_abstract: 摘要：准确、特定地点的信道信息对于优化下一代无线网络至关重要。在各种方法中，局部统计信道建模（LSCM）通过参考信号接收功率（RSRP）测量来建模信道多径角功率谱（APS），已成为一种专为高效网络优化而设计的最先进方法。然而，尽管其有效性，LSCM无法在绝大多数没有测量数据的位置预测APS，这严重限制了其在大规模真实场景中的应用。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了点云辅助的切向高斯溅射（PC-TGS），这是首个通过整合稀疏无线电测量与密集基于LiDAR的几何信息，将APS外推到未测量户外网格的框架。PC-TGS将环境散射体表示为各向异性的3D高斯，初始化和细化过程...
tldr: 本文提出点云辅助的切向高斯溅射（PC-TGS）框架，首次利用LiDAR几何信息与稀疏无线电测量结合，实现未测量户外位置的角功率谱预测，突破了传统局部统计信道建模的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PC-TGS, the first framework that integrates LiDAR-based geometry with sparse radio measurements to extrapolate angular power spectrum to unmeasured outdoor locations, overcoming the limitations of traditional localized statistical channel modeling.
